references.view: Full oblique exterior of Philippe Auguste column: cruciform low pediments, slender shaft, capital and standing green finial. The adjacent tall pavilion is excluded.

modelingNotes: This asset is the northern Philippe Auguste column, not both Trone columns or the adjacent pavilion. The chosen OSM way has a cruciform 4 m pedestal, small central 4.5 m parts and a 28 m overall height, but no mapped upper shaft.

The inspected Philippe Auguste column photograph establishes the slender fluted shaft, broad capital and green standing figure. Shaft center/radius follow the mapped central part; elevations 4.5–24 m for the shaft, 24–25.1 m for the capital and 28 m overall are explicit proportional inferences constrained by OSM total height.

The finial is an original abstract standing silhouette, not a reproduction of the statue. Fluting, reliefs, coats of arms, lettering and capital carving are omitted. Nearby gate pavilion and southern Saint-Louis column are outside this footprint.
